core_contribution.summary: Freeze the accepted visual standard as a reusable fact-slot-driven contract for every later README.

acceptance_checks_passed: The template reproduces the accepted Note macro-structure without embedding Note-specific prose as a portfolio default
Every variable visitor-facing product slot requires an explicit fact, configured standard, or omission disposition

Exactly one H1, one applicable badge row, list navigation, detailed product-specific Mermaid, readable license prose, conditional notices, conditional disclosures, no comments, no emojis, and no default copyright are enforced
The complete canonical product name is required in identity positions while package, namespace, command, import, and API shorthand remains limited to technical contexts
The template version, accepted-reference hash, prompt hashes, policy hashes, fact hash, and validator version participate in cache invalidation
